name: Itzagaondoa (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the arms of Itzagaondoa (a tree between rocks on a green mount on blue).
history: The flag is described as bearing the municipal arms centred on a red ground, surrounded by the name of the municipality in golden letters; the arms are timbred with a plumed helmet. This blue version with the arms is the one shown by the municipality.
